headline.text: L3 ML4 Theegarten wrappers were down *1–2 hours* for a software issue — techs brought them back by noon.

per_plant_summary.L1: S1 delayed start until 11:37 for EM-positive drain cleaning and swabbing. S3 tunnel belt replaced air suppressor and ran by 10:12. S4 coconut oil motor faulted overnight, reset by 07:48. Two unresolved: compressor 2 low-pressure alarm and broken decorator hose.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 metal detector blow-offs cleared after chicane and belt adjustments — ran well rest of shift. FFS web frame and film break both resolved same shift. No open issues at window close.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 Theegarten wrappers all failed 08:15 on incomplete format change and software fault, back by 11:31 after remote support. ML1 had recurring metal detector belt tracking issues and multiple minor stops. Five items still need attention: TG product blowing off, buffer tank leak, gondola breaking bars, air knife setup, and glycol level low.

notes.text: Kitchen 2 HMI upgrades completed with new admin password requirement for login.
365-day safety celebration with food truck 09:30–11:00 for first shift.
Tim and Bob on-site for plant walk; small tour planned for tomorrow.

resolved.title: S4 coconut oil motor not building pressure
resolved.summary: Pump protection activated overnight after heating zone turned off over weekend, solidifying oil in the line.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:48 — VFD reset, heating zone restarted, pump protection cleared, back up and running (Marcos Jimenez).

resolved.title: S3 tunnel 1 belt turning on then stopping
resolved.summary: Belt cycled on and immediately stopped, holding line down from 09:25 while maintenance diagnosed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:12 — maintenance replaced air suppressor, line back up and running (Justin Garner).

resolved.title: S1 EM-positive drain delayed start for cleaning
resolved.summary: Drain near S1 marshmallow mixing tested positive for environmental monitoring pathogen, requiring pre-start cleaning, vector swabbing, and second post-clean swabs before line could run.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:37 — Mary completed second swab collection, floor sanitized, and S1 started running (S1 Enrober, Mary Montilla).

resolved.title: S3 Russell Finex filter clogged on arrival
resolved.summary: Filter found clogged at shift start, preventing caramel flow to line.
resolved.resolution: Cleared same shift — operator unclogged filter and manually purged 3 buckets (S3 Enrober).

resolved.title: S3 separating table 1 flaps removed causing nut buildup
resolved.summary: Covers removed from separating table allowing nut accumulation underneath; root cause for removal unknown.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:24 — maintenance re-installed flaps, should see less nut buildup now (Caleb York).

resolved.title: ML2 metal detector blow-offs and jams
resolved.summary: High scrap rate (200 lbs by 06:56) from bars blowing off and jamming past metal detector, requiring multiple maintenance interventions.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by end of shift — adjusted 2nd chicane, speed/long belts, and cross conveyors; Dave confirmed "worked well all day" at 13:50.

resolved.title: FFS web frame out of range
resolved.summary: Line down at shift start for web frame positioning error, Justin working on adjustment.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:46 — "line is running" (Jeffrey Barney, VFFS).

resolved.title: FFS film broken
resolved.summary: Film break took line down at 12:07.

resolved.title: ML2 wrapper machine knife problems
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 14:55 for recurring issues with wrapper knives.

resolved.title: ML4 Theegarten wrappers software failure
resolved.summary: All three TG wrappers stopped working at 08:15 — belts not moving, incomplete gondola format change from prior shift, software issue across all units requiring remote support from Konstantin.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:31 — TG3 and TG4 ready, hoppers filled, depositing on dep 1 again (Itzel Chavez, ML4 TG).

resolved.title: Truffle Line Cavanna 1 exit belt issues
resolved.summary: Exit belt on Cavanna 1 repeatedly faulting and shutting line down at 06:38, again at 09:07; recurring mechanical issue requiring multiple tension adjustments.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by end of shift — tension adjusted at 06:47, loosened again at 12:21, belt speed reduced 195 to 185 at 12:54 (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 1 product appearance out of spec
resolved.summary: Chocolate bars coming out with bad appearance, production removing at demold to prevent packing; temper and circuit temps stable but line stopped to verify all temps.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:42 — "bars are looking better," appearance within spec, cleared to pack; all off-spec product removed at demold (Itzel Chavez, David Zuniaga).

resolved.title: ML1 Imperial valve air jam preventing purge
resolved.summary: Chocolate would not purge from pipeline when operator tried; suspected air pressure issue with valve not opening.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:20 — air jam on valve cleared (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML1 Imperial high temper
resolved.summary: Stopped sending chocolate to hopper after temper spiked into red zone; operator took second temper before adjusting while line was down.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:45 — adjustment made, starting back up (Imperial).

resolved.title: ML1 C1 conveyor stopping frequently
resolved.summary: Conveyor belt faulting and stopping repeatedly throughout morning, maintenance in line working on root cause.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:14 — "since 1:14 conveyor belt C1 has not stopped again" (Imperial at 13:47).

resolved.title: ML1 bars with hole in corner from wrapper
resolved.summary: 33% of bars (3 out of 10) had holes in corner; line stopped at 12:50 for maintenance adjustment.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:16 — cut and film position needed adjustment (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML4 licking roller 2 pump not working
resolved.summary: Pump failure caused bin to fill with chocolate, stopping line; same issue as last week.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:15 — breaker tripped, maintenance found and reset it, pump working (Shane Olsen, Efrain Rodriguez).

resolved.title: ML1 centerlines out of spec (5 readings)
resolved.summary: Five centerline measurements out of specification range, flagged to Shawn for adjustment.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:32 — lower crystallization by 0.2 per Shawn's direction, adjustment confirmed (Shawn Jewkes, Bojana McLeod).

resolved.title: Truffle Line QiSoft photo function failing
resolved.summary: System kicking operator out when attempting to take required hourly photo for production check.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:26 — Shawn fixed it, now letting them take photos (Shawn Jewkes, TruffleLine FW).

needs_attention.title: S4 Carastar send alarm blocking batch transfer
needs_attention.summary: Alarm preventing kitchen from sending finished batch to Carastar system; screenshot shows error but no diagnostic or workaround posted.
needs_attention.status: Blocking batch send as of 12:42; Chris Jeffs tagged but no response by window close.

needs_attention.title: S1 compressor 2 low pressure alarm
needs_attention.summary: Compressor 2 found in red with low-pressure alarm at shift start; no follow-up on cause or resolution posted.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 05:01; no update from maintenance or operators by window close.

needs_attention.title: S1 decorator hose broken
needs_attention.summary: Hose on decorator found broken; Justin asked how or when it happened but no response or repair status posted.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:40; no update on replacement or impact to production.

needs_attention.title: S3 cross conveyor 1 motor replacement in progress
needs_attention.summary: Cross conveyor not running even though HMI shows on; maintenance began motor replacement at 07:37 but no completion confirmation.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance replacing motor as of 07:37 (Justin Garner); line ran without it but no final status posted.

needs_attention.title: ML1 air knife configuration causing line faults
needs_attention.summary: Four air knives installed causing excessive air draw and low-pressure faults; Nathan reduced to one knife to run but asked Chris Givens for proper solution at 11:31.
needs_attention.status: Workaround in place (one knife plugged); permanent fix pending Chris Givens input as of 11:31.

needs_attention.title: ML1 Cavanna air pressure issues
needs_attention.summary: Cavanna wrapper experiencing air pressure problems at 10:22, maintenance working on it but no resolution posted.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working as of 10:22; no update on cause or completion.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG wrappers blowing off product
needs_attention.summary: All TG units blowing off full bars at 12:10; Peter working on it, root cause found on TG5 as motor installed incorrectly after cleaning, but no confirmation all three units resolved.
needs_attention.status: TG5 motor issue found and Blake working on it as of 12:48 (Ray Garcia); no update on TG3 or TG4 status.

needs_attention.title: ML4 buffer tank 1 depositor 2 leaking
needs_attention.summary: Tank leaking, Blake called at 12:40 but no follow-up on severity or repair.
needs_attention.status: Blake Heward tagged at 12:40; no update on leak source or containment.

needs_attention.title: ML4 gondola breaking bars intermittently
needs_attention.summary: Bars coming out of gondola broken; production person stationed to remove defective pieces at TG4 to protect quality, but gondola issue not fixed.
needs_attention.status: Mitigation in place (manual sorting) as of 13:45; Mirella flagged broken pieces again at 15:22; root cause unresolved.

needs_attention.title: Plant entry door not locking, badge reader bypassed
needs_attention.summary: Main entry door allowing employees to walk in without badges; both production floor door and main lobby door affected.
needs_attention.status: Benjamin asked William Lopez to check at 13:50 before calling Stone Security; Preston flagged lobby door not closing at 15:12; no resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: ML1 wrapper safety door opens during roll rotation
needs_attention.summary: Safety door on wrapper machine repeatedly opening every time film roll rotates; maintenance notified at 13:49 but no fix posted.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 13:49; no update on adjustment or sensor issue.

needs_attention.title: ML1 glycol level dropping to low mark
needs_attention.summary: Glycol level almost at "sad face" indicator at 14:00, still low at 14:27; maintenance called but no refill or leak check confirmation.
needs_attention.status: Flagged twice (14:00 and 14:27); Rose, Blake, and Nathan tagged but no response by window close.
